canvasFindings: W011 (nifty faces #16): The correctly composited image shows a bright yellow field — not a dark or neutral ground. The wedge and shard forms are multicolored line clusters (red, magenta, teal, green, white, purple, black) over that yellow, with white areas visible where lines are sparse. The two rectangular eye zones are small and partially buried in the line mass at center. The old description's reference to 'hard diagonal wedges' and 'shards' is directionally correct but missed the vivid yellow ground and the white canvas showing through sparse areas, making the composition lighter and more open than previously described.

W073 (nifty faces #9): The correctly composited image reveals a much more colorful and spatially complex work than the old description suggested. The background is not a uniform dark mass but a patchwork of orange, yellow, teal, and white areas with loose black loops at the edges. The face is built from dense purple, magenta, red, teal, and white scribble lines. The two eye forms are small, dark-outlined, and set within the scribble density but the surrounding field is visibly lighter and more varied in hue than previously described. The scribble lines are not uniformly short — many are looping and curved.

W075 (nifty faces #13): The correctly composited image confirms the yellow border and red field. The interior is densely packed with multicolored crossing lines (blue, magenta, green, teal, red, orange, white) over a white-canvas base that shows through in the tooth area and some interior gaps. The triangular teeth are white with black outlines, clearly visible. The wavy white line at top is prominent. The description's reference to 'triangular teeth' is accurate but the teeth are more prominent white shapes than previously conveyed. The interior density is high but white gaps are visible throughout.

W089 (nifty faces #3): The correctly composited image shows a much more structured and colorful work than the old description implied. The background is a mottled teal-green and yellow field, not a uniformly dark or dense ground. The face has a prominent red-filled crown/hat area at top, bold black outlines, a clearly readable squared eye with nested rectangles, a red-arc mouth with white teeth, and magenta and black scribble lines throughout. The composition is less dissolved than described — the face structure is more legible, with distinct color zones (red, green, yellow, teal) and the black outlines are heavy and defining rather than lost in density.

W094 (nifty faces #7): The correctly composited image shows the red field is vivid and dominant. The face has large squared eye-frames with white interiors and teal/black scribbled pupils, a wide tooth-filled mouth with prominent white triangular teeth, and a yellow scribble crown at top. Teal outline loops extend into the red field at the edges. The face is not flat or mask-like in a simple sense — it has considerable internal color variation (green, teal, blue, yellow within the face zone). The description's 'mask-like flatness' undersells the internal complexity now visible with correct alpha.

W107 (nifty faces #57): The correctly composited image shows a white-dominant ground with yellow, orange, blue, teal, and green color zones. The four quadrants are visible but the dividing lines are loose black outlines, not rigid. The upper-left quadrant contains a spiked circle eye on a green ground; upper-right has a spiked circle with a red cross on a lighter ground. Lower-left has a rectangular tooth/mouth form with white interior stripes; lower-right has a similar barred rectangle. The overall ground is light and open — white canvas shows through extensively. The old description's 'barred rectangles' for the lower zones is accurate. The composition is lighter and more open than previously described.

W128 (nifty faces #5): The correctly composited image shows the background is a dense field of magenta/crimson looping scrawl with black diagonal stripe-like marks and white gaps — not a uniformly dark magenta. The face is built from multicolored looping lines (blue, green, yellow, white, red, magenta) and is readable as a frontal face with eyes, nose, and mouth suggested by line compression. The background's black diagonal marks were previously invisible due to incorrect alpha handling; they are now visible as a structural element competing with the face. The face is more clearly differentiated from the background than the old description suggested.

W129 (nifty faces #10): The correctly composited image shows a pale yellow border/field with a tilted rectangular face-form filled with dense crossing lines in teal, magenta, green, black, red, orange, and white. The yellow field is light and open, contrasting strongly with the dense interior. Two small spiral eye forms are visible within the crossing-line mass. White loops are visible over the dense interior. The bottom of the tilted form shows white gaps where the canvas shows through. The old description's 'spiral eye forms' is confirmed. The yellow ground is softer and more open than previously conveyed.

W133 (nifty faces #12): The correctly composited image confirms a white-ground composition with no filled background — the areas outside the rectangular face-forms are white canvas with loose colored line extensions (red, black, green, blue, magenta). The two large boxed spiral eyes are prominent: left eye has red/purple concentric spirals on a yellow interior; right eye has red spirals on a lighter interior with a white center. The zigzag-mouth rectangle at bottom contains white zigzag teeth on a black-and-color ground. The background is not 'fully saturated' — it is largely white with colored line marks. This significantly affects the transition description from W129.

title: Lines Beyond the Face
question: What changes when lines extend beyond the outline of a head?
introduction: Start with heads whose boundaries remain easy to follow, then look at the marks extending into the surrounding space. Diagonals, loops and crossing lines connect the features to a larger pattern. Later works make that separation less clear. Follow one line outward and notice when it stops describing a face.
closing: Choose a line that crosses a head's edge. Does it link the face to its surroundings, or make the edge more difficult to follow?

chapters.title: The Boundary Holds
chapters.introduction: Four works where a recognizable face dominates the composition, even as lines press against its edges and begin to extend past them into the surrounding field.

stops.whyHere: Pointed animal ears, scribbled oval eye zones, and bared teeth lock the face in place; loose colored loops spilling into the open teal ground are the first visible sign of outward pressure.
stops.title: nnxyz nifty faces #117

stops.whyHere: A thick black scaffold holds the rectangular head firm against a saturated red field framed by a hard yellow border; a prominent wavy white line crowns the top, white triangular teeth read clearly against the black-outlined mouth rectangle, and crossing lines in magenta, green, blue, and teal flood every interior surface, with white canvas visible through gaps in the density.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Where the first work leaks loosely into open teal, this one is hemmed by a hard yellow border and a red field — the pressure is comparable but the container is visibly tighter, and white gaps in the interior confirm the line density rather than a filled ground.
stops.title: nnxyz nifty faces #13

stops.whyHere: Large squared eye-frames with white interiors and teal-scribbled pupils, a wide tooth-filled mouth with prominent white triangular teeth, and a yellow scribble crown give the face considerable internal color variation against a vivid red field; teal outline loops extending into that red field signal that the boundary is already giving way despite the face's internal complexity.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The previous work holds its shape through thick black scaffolding with a yellow border containing the red; here the yellow border is gone and the red field presses directly against the face's teal and green interior zones, making the boundary feel more contested even as the face's own structure remains readable.
stops.title: nnxyz nifty faces #7

stops.whyHere: A rigid cyan-and-white outline holds a near-square head against dark navy; magenta concentric-ring eyes pull attention inward while ribbon lines of cyan, red, and yellow spill into all four corners.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The previous work's red field pushes inward from outside; here the dark navy recedes and the face's own lines are what escape outward into the corners — pressure direction reverses.
stops.title: nnxyz nifty faces #24

chapters.title: Overflow as the Main Event
chapters.introduction: Five works where the lines escaping the face are as visually prominent as the face itself — the boundary and the field competing on equal terms for attention.

stops.whyHere: Mismatched eye heights and a striped mouth anchor the face, but the spiky scribble field pressing inward from every edge competes with the features for attention.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The previous work's overflow stays ribbon-like and peripheral; here the scribble mass is dense enough to crowd the face from all sides simultaneously.
stops.title: nnxyz nifty faces #127

stops.whyHere: Red X marks inside heavily cross-hatched oval eyes and a grimace-wide tooth band hold the center, while colored lines spill past the face edge into a jagged, unclosed border.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The previous work's scribble field presses inward toward the face; here the lines press outward — direction reverses, but the face is equally contested in both.
stops.title: nnxyz nifty faces #107

stops.whyHere: Hard wedge and shard forms in red, magenta, teal, green, and black shoot to every edge of a bright yellow field; white canvas shows through wherever lines thin, making the composition simultaneously dense at center and open at the periphery. Two small rectangular eye zones at center are the only still point in a composition that pulls entirely outward.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The previous work retains a closed face shape with leaking edges against a dark ground; here the ground is a saturated yellow and closure is abandoned — multicolored shards dominate and the face is reconstructed only from what the crossing lines leave at center.
stops.title: nnxyz nifty faces #16

stops.whyHere: Looping yellow lines spread like unraveling wire across the upper half while the stacked-block face below holds firm; the hot-pink field and cool layered shapes at right pull in opposite directions.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The previous work's overflow is sharp and angular; here hard wedges give way to looping wire — the energy is comparable but the texture shifts from shards to coils.
stops.title: nnxyz nifty faces #30

stops.whyHere: Bold black outlines and distinct color zones — a red-filled crown, teal-green and yellow face areas, a clearly nested-square eye, and a red-arc mouth with white teeth — hold the face more legibly than the surrounding magenta and black scribble lines suggest; those scribbles spill into all four corners of a mottled teal and yellow field without fully dissolving the structure beneath.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The previous work keeps a firm block-face anchoring the lower half against a hot-pink field; here the face retains bold outlines and distinct color zones but the scribble lines are denser and the ground breaks into teal, green, and yellow patches — the face is legible but the surrounding field is more active and less unified.
stops.title: nnxyz nifty faces #3

chapters.title: Density Without Outline
chapters.introduction: Three works where the face emerges from accumulated marks rather than drawn edges — features readable only because lines pile up more thickly in some areas than others.

stops.whyHere: Looping and short scribble lines in purple, magenta, red, teal, and white accumulate across a patchwork of orange, yellow, and teal ground areas until the face is a site of density; two small dark-outlined eye forms are the only fixed points inside the surrounding chromatic noise.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The previous work still has a legible arc-mouth and squared eye against a teal-green field; here those anchors reduce to two small dark forms nearly swallowed by the scribble mass, and the ground beneath breaks into warm and cool color patches rather than holding a single tone.
stops.title: nnxyz nifty faces #9

stops.whyHere: The face is built entirely from multicolored looping lines — blue, green, yellow, white, red, magenta — with no solid fills; features emerge only where loops compress most tightly, and the background's dense magenta scrawl punctuated by black diagonal marks and white gaps pushes the face forward without a hard edge doing that work.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The previous work's scribble lines are short and directional over a patchwork warm-and-cool ground; here long looping coils replace them and the background adds bold black diagonal marks visible through the magenta density — the face becomes even less outlined and more accumulated, but the background is more structurally active than before.
stops.title: nnxyz nifty faces #5

stops.whyHere: Pale radiating spikes dissolve the head's boundary into the warm looping background; the tooth-filled mouth with its hard black outlines is the one remaining anchor where figure and field share the same line weight everywhere else.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The previous work holds the face forward through contrast with a busy background; here face and ground use identical line weight, and the boundary nearly disappears.
stops.title: nnxyz nifty faces #25

chapters.title: The Grid Imposed on the Dissolving Face
chapters.introduction: Three works that place rectangular framing or a structural grid over a face already losing its boundary — testing whether geometry can recover what the overflow has dispersed. In each, the ground beneath the grid remains open rather than saturated, and the white canvas itself becomes part of the answer.

stops.whyHere: Four loosely divided quadrants on a largely white and open ground place face-parts — two spiked-circle eyes, one with a red cross, and two barred rectangular mouth-forms with white interiors — as arranged elements rather than a unified drawn face; the white canvas showing through extensively makes the grid feel provisional rather than structural.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The previous work dissolves the face through shared line weight against a busy looping background; here a loose quadrant grid attempts to reassemble face-parts on an open white ground — but the grid's own lines are soft and the white space between elements keeps the reassembly incomplete.
stops.title: nnxyz nifty faces #57

stops.whyHere: A tilted rectangular form densely packed with crossing lines in teal, magenta, green, black, red, and orange sits against a soft pale yellow field; two small spiral eye forms anchor the composition while white loops and the yellow ground's openness contrast sharply with the interior density, making the tilt feel like pressure rather than geometry.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The previous work divides into four roughly equal zones on an open white ground; here the whole structure tilts and the pale yellow field replaces white openness — the grid feels less like a container and more like another layer of pressure bearing down on the dense interior.
stops.title: nnxyz nifty faces #10

stops.whyHere: Strict rectangular framing — two large boxed spiral eyes with red and purple concentric rings, one long zigzag-mouth rectangle with white teeth — holds the composition together on a largely white ground; colored line extensions in red, black, green, blue, and magenta reach into the white surround without filling it, making the rectangles the dominant visual fact against open space rather than a saturated field.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The previous work's tilted grid sits against a soft yellow field; here the rectangles are upright, the ground is white and open, and the spiral eyes and zigzag mouth assert the last clear structural claim the face can make — geometry holds where density alone could not.
stops.title: nnxyz nifty faces #12
